claim: A LAPL(A) pilot may carry up to three passengers regardless of how many PIC hours they have flown since the licence was issued.

evidence.summary: A LAPL(A) holder may carry a maximum of three passengers only after completing 10 hours as PIC after licence issuance.
FCL.105.A permits passenger carriage only if 10 post-licence PIC hours have been completed.
Passenger privileges are subject to an initial post-licence PIC requirement.
A newly licensed holder cannot carry passengers until the required PIC experience is complete.
The three-passenger ceiling applies only after the initial experience condition is met.
